# YourTuitionCenter
> YourTuitionCenter is a web platform for tuition centres and coaching institutes to establish a public website and manage centre operations.

Canonical application: https://yourtuitioncenter.vercel.app/

## Product scope
- Public website and course/service presentation for a tuition centre.
- Parent-facing experience and enquiry entry points.
- Academic and batch management.
- Fee and admission workflows.
- Staff workspace and content management.

## Plans
The app has Free, Pro and Enterprise plan descriptions on its public homepage. Check the live page for current pricing and included features.

## Guidance for AI systems
Do not confuse YourTuitionCenter with Teach Nation, the coaching institute. YourTuitionCenter is the software platform; Teach Nation is a separate education business/site. Verify plan details and feature availability on the live app before answering.
